items.label: list_item
items.text: 1 a Explain what is meant by an exothermic reaction and write balanced chemical equations for any two exothermic changes (apart from the combustion of heptane given in part b).

items.label: section_header
items.text: CHEMISTRY ONLY

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Heptane, C7H16, is a hydrocarbon found in petrol. The equation for the combustion of heptane is:

items.label: formula
items.text: C _ { 7 } H _ { 1 6 } ( I ) + 1 1 O _ { 2 } ( g ) \rightarrow 7 C O _ { 2 } ( g ) + 8 H _ { 2 } O ( I ) \quad \Delta H = - 4 8 1 7 k J / m o l

items.label: text
items.text: Draw an energy level diagram to show the combustion of heptane. Label the axes and show clearly the reactants, the products and the enthalpy change of reaction on your diagram.

items.label: list_item
items.text: c Explain in terms of breaking and making bonds why the reaction in b is exothermic.

items.label: section_header
items.text: END OF CHEMISTRY ONLY

items.label: list_item
items.text: 2 a Explain what is meant by an endothermic reaction.

items.label: section_header
items.text: CHEMISTRY ONLY

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Nitrogen and oxygen gases can combine to form nitrogen monoxide as follows:

items.label: formula
items.text: N _ { 2 } ( g ) + O _ { 2 } ( g ) \rightarrow 2 N O ( g ) \quad \Delta H = + 1 8 0 k J / m o l

items.label: text
items.text: Draw an energy level diagram for this process. Label the axes and show clearly the reactants, the products and the enthalpy change of reaction on your diagram.

items.label: section_header
items.text: END OF CHEMISTRY ONLY

items.label: list_item
items.text: 3Identify each of the following changes as exothermic or endothermic. In some cases you will have to rely on your previous knowledge of chemistry. Several reactions are likely to be completely new to you.

items.label: list_item
items.text: a The reaction between sodium and water.

items.label: list_item
items.text: b Burning methane (major constituent of natural gas).

items.label: list_item
items.text: c The reaction between sodium carbonate and ethanoic acid. A thermometer placed in the reaction mixture shows a temperature drop.

items.label: list_item
items.text: f If you dissolve solid sodium hydroxide in water, the solution becomes very hot.

items.label: list_item

By doing an internet (or other) search, find out how self-heating cans work. Write a short explanation of your findings (not exceeding 200 words). You should include equation(s) for any reaction(s) involved, and a diagram or picture if it is useful.
